from pathlib import Path
import json
root=Path('E:/PCControlAutonomyR41')
stem='STOP_R41_USER_OBSERVER'
script=root/(stem+'.ps1')
cmd=root/(stem+'.cmd')
if script.exists() or cmd.exists():raise RuntimeError('SAFE_STOP_ALREADY_EXISTS_DO_NOT_OVERWRITE')
sha='506f9a951f9b782e27b0d886e441b6747095e3fc'
target=str(root/'releases'/sha/'bin/pc-autonomy-daemon.js')

$target = '%s'
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $startup) {
  $text = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $startup
  if (-not $text.Contains($expected) -or $text.Contains('--dispatch')) {
    throw 'R41_STOP_REFUSED_UNEXPECTED_STARTUP_CONTENT'
  }
  Remove-Item -LiteralPath $startup -ErrorAction Stop
  Write-Output 'R41 Startup entry disabled'
}
$rows = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object {

  $_.CommandLine.Contains($target) -and $_.CommandLine.Contains('--watch') -and
  (-not $_.CommandLine.Contains('--dispatch'))
})
foreach ($row in $rows) {
  Stop-Process -Id $row.ProcessId -Force -ErrorAction Stop
  Write-Output ('Stopped exact R41 observer PID: ' + $row.ProcessId)
}

"""%(expected.replace("'","''"),target.replace("'","''"))

cmd.write_text('@echo off\r\npowershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "'+str(script)+'"\r\npause\r\n',encoding='utf-8')
